source: CoreGuard Quilla Cyber Codex (original educational summaries; cites public frameworks)

entries.title: Incident response phases (NIST-style)
entries.body: Preparation builds tooling and playbooks. Detection notices anomalies. Analysis confirms scope. Containment stops spread. Eradication removes cause. Recovery restores trust. Lessons update defenses. Mobile IR often starts with isolate-from-network and preserve evidence.
entries.defense: If Nemesis shows PRIVACY THREAT indicators: enable Shield, avoid sensitive logins, capture Compliance/scan notes, and consider factory reset only after evidence needs are met.

entries.title: Mobile device triage checklist
entries.summary: Fast steps when you suspect device compromise.
entries.body: 1) Note symptoms and recent installs/links. 2) Run an on-device IOC/privacy scan. 3) Enable network filtering if available. 4) Change critical passwords from a clean device. 5) Revoke app sessions. 6) Preserve logs/exports before wipe. 7) Rebuild from clean backup if needed.
entries.defense: CoreGuard: Scanner → Shield → Compliance export (Premium) → Timeline. Quilla coaches next steps from local evidence.

entries.title: Indicators of compromise (IOCs)
entries.summary: Observable artifacts that suggest malicious activity.
entries.body: IOCs include package names, domains, IPs, file paths, and hashes. STIX packages share them between tools. IOCs go stale; combine with behavior. False positives happen — treat matches as leads.
entries.defense: Premium signature refresh pulls newer open-source IOCs before rescan. Bundled indicators cover offline triage.

entries.title: Android containment options
entries.summary: Limit attacker reach while you investigate.
entries.body: Airplane mode / disable Wi‑Fi & mobile data, revoke suspicious app permissions, force-stop/uninstall unknown apps, enable DNS sinkhole/VPN filter, remove unknown device admins, and escalate to wipe if persistence is likely and evidence is secured.
entries.defense: CoreGuard Shield is a local DNS sinkhole — useful containment assist, not a full EDR.
